author: ValWood
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**

IPR001126   DNA repair
 
* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**


SPBC1347.01c | rev1 | deoxycytidyl transferase Rev1
SPCC553.07c | kpa1 | DinB translesion DNA repair polymerase, pol kappa
SPBC16A3.11 | eso1 | mitotic cohesin N-acetyltransferase/DNA polymerase eta Eso1 fusion protein

[SPBC1347.01c](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC1347.01c)	[rev1](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC1347.01c)	deoxycytidyl transferase Rev1
[SPCC553.07c](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPCC553.07c)	[kpa1](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPCC553.07c)	DinB translesion DNA repair polymerase, pol kappa
[SPBC16A3.11](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC16A3.11)	[eso1](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC16A3.11)	mitotic cohesin N-acetyltransferase/DNA polymerase eta Eso1 fusion protein

Strictly speaking, this is translesion synthesis https://www.pombase.org/term/GO:0019985 which is  "DNA damage tolerance" not DNA repair


* **Description of issue**
title: InterPro2GO issue: IPR001126       DNA repair
